name: rosetta-closest-pair-problem
code:
use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

struct P(x: double, y: double) is
    -(o: P) -> P => P(x - o.x, y - o.y)
    length: double => Math.sqrt(x * x + y * y)
    show: string => "({x:F4}, {y:F4})"
si

use Pair = (distance: double, a: P, b: P)

closer(p: Pair, q: Pair) -> Pair =>
    if q.distance < p.distance then q else p fi

pair(a: P, b: P) -> Pair => ((a - b).length, a, b)

brute_force(points: List[P]) -> Pair =>
    (0..points.count)
        |> flat_map(i =>
            (i + 1..points.count) |> map(j => pair(points[i], points[j])))
        |> reduce((double.max_value, points[0], points[0]), closer)

closest(by_x: List[P], by_y: List[P]) -> Pair is
    if by_x.count <= 3 then
        return brute_force(by_x)
    fi

    let half = by_x.count / 2
    let middle = by_x[half - 1].x

    let left_x = by_x |> take(half) |> collect_list()
    let right_x = by_x |> skip(half) |> collect_list()
    let left = SET(left_x)

    let left_y = by_y |> filter(p => left.contains(p)) |> collect_list()
    let right_y = by_y |> filter(p => !left.contains(p)) |> collect_list()

    let best = closer(closest(left_x, left_y), closest(right_x, right_y))

    let strip =
        by_y
            |> filter(p => Math.abs(p.x - middle) < best.distance)
            |> collect_list()

    let result mut = best

    for (i, p) in strip |> index() do
        for q in strip |> skip(i + 1) do
            if q.y - p.y >= result.distance then
                break
            fi

            result = closer(result, pair(p, q))
        od
    od

    result
si

let random = System.Random(2)
let points =
    (0..2000)
        |> map(_ => P(random.next_double(), random.next_double()))
        |> collect_list()

let fast =
    closest(
        points |> sort((a, b) => a.x <> b.x) |> collect_list(),
        points |> sort((a, b) => a.y <> b.y) |> collect_list())

let slow = brute_force(points)

write_line("{points.count} random points in the unit square")
write_line("divide and conquer: {fast.distance:F6}")
write_line("between {fast.a.show} and {fast.b.show}")
write_line("brute force:        {slow.distance:F6}")

let image = IMAGE(400, 400)

image.view(0.0D, 0.0D, 1.0D, 1.0D)
image.clear(252ub, 250ub, 245ub)
image.colour(120ub, 130ub, 150ub)

for p in points do
    image.dot(p.x, p.y, 1.5D)
od

image.colour(210ub, 40ub, 40ub)
image.ring(fast.a.x, fast.a.y, 7.0D)
image.ring(fast.b.x, fast.b.y, 7.0D)

image.write("closest.png")

image.show("closest.png")
